answer: Each epoch a beacon samples 5% of agents and orders each to re-run one past job on fresh inputs in 24 hours. The agent publishes inputs, outputs, log; verifiers replay and compare hashes. Mismatch, missing log, or no-show suspends identity and burns its 2-token bond. A forger must keep real capability per fake, not just a key. Ten jobs cost $0.40 and 15 minutes each, so 100 fakes cost $400 and 250 hours; honest pay nothing. Like a ledge holding only a climber who can stand on it, the test drops weightless copies; a timber frame bears the load or not, and no zephyr pushes it over.
